treaty_name: Agreement between the Government of Canada and the Government of the Slovak Republic for the Avoidance of Double Taxation and the Prevention of Fiscal Evasion with respect to Taxes on Income and on Capital (2001; modified by MLI)
eif_quote: Treaty-accord (Canada Treaty Series 2001/37): "Entry into Force 18 December 2001" | Income Tax Conventions Implementation Act, 2001, Part 7 (conflicting): "[Note: Agreement in force December 20, 2001, see Canada Gazette Part I, Volume 136, page 362.]"
source_title: Income Tax Conventions Implementation Act, 2001 (S.C. 2001, c. 30), Schedule 7 - Canada-Slovak Republic Agreement (Justice Laws consolidated text)

rates.quote: a) except in the case of dividends paid by a non-resident-owned investment corporation, 5 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends if the beneficial owner is a company which controls directly or indirectly at least 10 per cent of the voting power in the company paying the dividends; [MLI art. 8(1): 365-day holding period, effective for WHT from 2020-01-01]
b) 15 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends, in all other cases.

2 However, such interest may also be taxed in the Contracting State in which it arises and according to the laws of that State, but if the beneficial owner of the interest is a resident of the other Contracting State, the tax so charged shall not exceed 10 per cent of the gross amount of the interest.

rates.article: Article 12(2) (royalties other than copyright in Art. 12(3))
rates.quote: 2 However, such royalties may also be taxed in the Contracting State in which they arise and according to the laws of that State, but if the beneficial owner of the royalties is a resident of the other Contracting State, the tax so charged shall not exceed 10 per cent of the gross amount of the royalties.

3 Notwithstanding the provisions of paragraph 2, copyright royalties and other like payments in respect of the production or reproduction of any literary, dramatic, musical or other artistic work (but not including royalties in respect of motion picture films nor royalties in respect of works on film or videotape or other means of reproduction for use in connection with television broadcasting) arising in a Contracting State and paid to a resident of the other Contracting State who is the beneficial owner of the royalties shall be taxable only in that other State.

ppt.quote: 1 Notwithstanding any provisions of a Covered Tax Agreement, a benefit under the Covered Tax Agreement shall not be granted in respect of an item of income or capital if it is reasonable to conclude; having regard to all relevant facts and circumstances, that obtaining that benefit was one of the principal purposes of any arrangement or transaction that resulted directly or indirectly in that benefit, unless it is established that granting that benefit in these circumstances would be in accordance with the object and purpose of the relevant provisions of the Covered Tax Agreement.

notes: Art. 29(1): effective for tax withheld at source on amounts paid or credited on or after 1 January of the year following entry into force (2002-01-01). EIF conflict: treaty-accord.gc.ca and map give 18 December 2001 (used); the Canada Gazette note in the implementing Act gives 20 December 2001 - same valid_from either way. Replaced the 1990 Canada-Czechoslovakia Convention as between Canada and Slovakia. Dividend 5% tier: company which "controls directly or indirectly at least 10 per cent of the voting power" (voting test recorded as ownership_threshold 10); excludes dividends paid by a non-resident-owned investment corporation. MLI art. 8 365-day holding applies: Canada notified "68 Slovak Republic Article 10(2)(a)", Slovakia notified "22 Canada Article 10(2)(a)"; effective 2020-01-01. Not modelled: Art. 11(3) exemptions (government debt; export/import loans by wholly government-owned entities).
